doc_kind: coverage policy (Medical Coverage Policy 0158 'Surgical Treatments for Obstructive Sleep Apnea')
lines_of_business: Health benefit plans administered by Cigna Companies; 'In certain markets, delegated vendor guidelines may be used'
criteria_location: Coverage Policy pp.2-4; Coding p.4-6. General Background (pp.6-24) is evidence only.
procedures_covered: HGNS (Inspire, Genio) adult and pediatric Down syndrome; remote replacement
Investigational: atrial pacing, CAPSO, snoreplasty, Pillar, RF, tongue-base suspension, TPAP

logic.top_level: pathways: one 'when ALL of the following criteria are met' block per procedure; DISE uses EITHER
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Explicit not-medically-necessary and experimental lists; no patient contraindication list for HGNS beyond the criteria (DISE concentric collapse, central+mixed apneas).
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Remote replacement for HGNS when malfunctioning and out of warranty; batteries not necessary. DISE also for 'persistent OSA after surgical intervention'. Multi-level surgery may be 'stepwise multiple procedures'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: criteria for PAP met and documentation that demonstrates PAP treatment failure defined as an inability to eliminate OSA (AHI > 15); OR PAP intolerance defined as inability to use PAP > 4 hours of use per night, 5 nights per week; OR unwillingness to use PAP
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Three-way OR inside one bullet of an ALL list, after 'criteria for PAP met' (which lives in another policy). Repeated verbatim in six places. 'AHI > 15' here vs '>= 15' in the HGNS bullet.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: for OSA in an adult, consideration has also been given to use of mandibular repositioning appliance (MRA) or tongue-retaining appliance
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'consideration has been given' is satisfied by documentation of consideration, not a trial; MMA says 'considered and found to be ineffective or undesirable'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: inability to use PAP > 4 hours of use per night, 5 nights per week
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: No time window and no percentage; 'inability to use ... >4 hours' - is it every night?

and_or_ambiguity.quote: age, AHI on polysomnography (PSG), and body mass index (BMI)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: A criterion that is a table; device-specific rows. Rows are alternatives by device, columns are ANDed.

requirement_kinds.quote: considered medically necessary for the treatment of moderate to severe OSA in an adult ... AHI on PSG >= 15 and <= 100 events per hour (Inspire); >= 15 and <= 65 (Genio)
central + mixed apneas <= 25% of total AHI
absence of a complete concentric collapse at the soft palate level on drug induced sleep endoscopy

PAP treatment failure ... (AHI >= 15); OR PAP intolerance ... > 4 hours of use per night, 5 nights per week; OR unwillingness to use PAP (e.g., a patient returns the PAP system after attempting to use it)
demonstrated narrowing or collapse of the retropalatal region ... as a source of airway obstruction
narrowing of multiple sites in the upper airway
individual has craniofacial disproportion or deformities
an MRA or tongue-retaining appliance has been considered and found to be ineffective or undesirable
Maxillomandibular advancement is considered medically necessary for the treatment of severe OSA

13-18 years; AHI > 10 and < 50; BMI <= 95th percentile for age; contraindicated for, or not effectively treated by adenotonsillectomy; failed or cannot tolerate PAP; all other alternative/adjunct therapies have been considered
documentation confirming that the remote is malfunctioning and is no longer under warranty
persistent OSA when criteria for positive airway pressure (PAP) met and documentation that demonstrates PAP treatment failure

thresholds.quote: central + mixed apneas ≤ 25% of total AHI
> 4 hours of use per night, 5 nights per week

time_windows.quote: > 4 hours of use per night, 5 nights per week

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Codes grouped by status heading ('Considered Medically Necessary when criteria ... are met', 'Not Medically Necessary ... stand-alone uvulectomy', 'Experimental') but not per procedure.

external_dependencies.what: PAP criteria and HSAT/PSG criteria in another policy
external_dependencies.quote: Criteria for the home sleep apnea testing (HSAT) and PSG testing pre- and post-upper airway hypoglossal nerve stimulator implantation are covered in the Sleep Disordered Breathing Diagnosis and Treatment Guidelines.
In certain markets, delegated vendor guidelines may be used to support medical necessity and other coverage determinations.
Refer to the customer's benefit plan document for coverage details.
Orthognathic Surgery; Bariatric Surgery and Procedures; Diaphragmatic/Phrenic Nerve Stimulation

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: an inability to eliminate OSA (apnea-hypopnea index [AHI] > 15)
inability to use PAP > 4 hours of use per night, 5 nights per week

vague_terms.quote: consideration has also been given to use of mandibular repositioning appliance
vague_terms.problem: does not say tried or failed

vague_terms.quote: all other alternative/adjunct therapies have been considered
narrowing or collapse of the retropalatal region

extraction_hazards: Device table (age/AHI/BMI by device) flattened into columns that lose which row each number belongs to
The long PAP-failure sentence is repeated verbatim in six criteria blocks
Instructions-for-Use boilerplate before criteria; General Background ~20 pages with literature that mentions numbers that look like thresholds
Deviation: '(AHI > 15)' vs '(AHI ≥ 15)' in the same document
Document file name truncates and says 'diagnosis-and-treatment' but content is surgical treatments
interesting_structures: Device-specific eligibility table (Inspire vs Genio) with different age/AHI/BMI
Explicit not-medically-necessary treatment for stand-alone uvulectomy and snoring

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Clean all/any blocks, but device-specific table rows are an extra dimension (any-of devices, each with its own all-of), and criteria depend on a PAP policy not included.
